# Generated by package_validation_artifacts.py

The ZIP retains all non-transient result-root files, including raw failures, logs, commands, actual Circle/NPZ/PNG artifacts, checkpoints, and selected pretrained assets. Excluded cache paths and reasons are in PACKAGE_EXCLUSIONS.json. HF cache provenance and the actual cached test[:12] rows are retained in PACKAGE_HF_DATASET_PROVENANCE.json and PACKAGE_HF_TEST_SAMPLES.json.

artifact_manifest.json hashes every included regular file except itself. The ZIP includes that manifest. Archive checksum and final packaging execution metadata are adjacent to the ZIP, outside result_root, to avoid recursive hashes and post-seal log mutations.

Use commands.sh for validation commands and PACKAGE_REPRO_COMMAND.sh for packaging. Verify the ZIP with:

    python package_validation_artifacts.py --verify-archive /workspace/shared/downloads/TICO_PR1073_validation_20261022T0404Z.zip
